decisions.reason: Changing the switched 5V rail enable pin from GPIO3 to GPIO5 does not alter the battery connector, pinout, voltage range, or AXP2101 destination.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing the LED-supplying 5V rail control from GPIO3 to GPIO5.
The 5V_EN reassignment does not change the charge-status indicator, its GPIO13 signal, connector, resistor, or population settings.
The GPIO reassignment does not affect the AXP2101 VMID-to-VSYS topology or VSYS net labeling.
The source decision changes a 5V boost-enable GPIO and does not alter battery protection behavior or thresholds.
Battery temperature sensing through the J_BAT NTC remains unchanged.
The GPIO reassignment has no necessary effect on the power board's eight-layer stack requirement.
The source decision does not change board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, enclosure fit, or connector placement.
Changing 5V_EN to GPIO5 does not alter the TVS-based ESD protection requirement.
The source decision does not affect the USB-C connector's data-line or sourceability requirements.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording GPIO5 for 5V_EN, GPIO38 for SCL0, and GPIO26 for SPI MOSI.
The 5V boost-enable pin change does not alter the 3.3V source OR-ing method, source set, or source-selection behavior.
